meta.title: 换行不换岗，换岗不换行｜职业选择避坑
meta.title_en: Switch Industry or Role, Not Both: Smart Career Pivots

scenes.context: 讲者指出很多工作多年的人一直在走弯路，做了一堆不想干、价值感弱的螺丝钉工作。
sentences: 很多工作了很多年的粉丝，前面一直都在走弯路。
Many followers who've worked for years have been going down detours the whole time.
走弯路：go down detours
找了一堆自己不想干、不能持续发展的螺丝钉工作。
They've landed one dead-end job after another that they don't want and can't grow in.
螺丝钉工作：dead-end jobs
越来越迷茫，越来越不知道自己适合什么工作。
They feel more and more lost, with no idea what kind of work fits them.
越来越迷茫：more and more lost
paraphrase: 迷茫的根源 → 是方法而不是能力
The root of the confusion is method, not ability.
多年经验 ≠ 多年积累 → 可能是弯路
Years of work aren't years of growth—they might be a detour.
scenes.speak: Many followers who've worked for years have been going down detours the whole time. They've landed one dead-end job after another that they don't want and can't grow in. They feel more and more lost, with no idea what kind of work fits them.

scenes.context: 讲者给出职场老人的核心策略：换行不换岗、换岗不换行，至少守住一个。
sentences: 职业的选择一定是要做守，行业跟岗位至少守得住一个。
Career choices should be about keeping an anchor—hold on to at least one of industry or role.
做守：keep an anchor
要么换行不换岗，要么换岗不换行。
Either switch industry while keeping the role, or switch roles while staying in the industry.
换行不换岗：switch industry, keep role
两个都舍弃，沉没成本太大，过往经历没有发挥价值。
Abandoning both makes the sunk cost huge and your past experience worthless.
沉没成本：sunk cost
paraphrase: 守一项 → 让经验能迁移
Keeping one anchor lets your experience transfer.
双重转型 → 双重归零
Changing both means starting from zero twice.
scenes.speak: Career choices should be about keeping an anchor—hold on to at least one of industry or role. Either switch industry while keeping the role, or switch roles while staying in the industry. Abandoning both makes the sunk cost huge and your past experience worthless.

scenes.context: 讲者给职场新人建议：从专业、兴趣、性格三维探索方向，锁定一个长期深耕。
sentences: 刚进入职场一两年的同学，处于职业的探索期，迷茫很正常。
If you're one or two years into your career, you're in the exploration phase—feeling lost is normal.
职业探索期：exploration phase
专业决定能不能入门，兴趣决定动力，性格决定能不能长久。
Your major decides if you can get in, interest decides your drive, and personality decides if you can last.
能不能入门：whether you can get in
选择几个方向大胆尝试，最后锁定一个方向长期深耕。
Try several directions boldly, then settle on one and go deep over the long run.
长期深耕：go deep over the long run
paraphrase: 三维度 = 入门、动力、持久
Three dimensions: entry, drive, and staying power.
先试几个 → 再锁一个
Try a few first, then commit to one.
scenes.speak: If you're one or two years into your career, you're in the exploration phase—feeling lost is normal. Your major decides if you can get in, interest decides your drive, and personality decides if you can last. Try several directions boldly, then settle on one and go deep over the long run.

practice: I'm switching industries, but I'll stay in the same role.
Changing both would make my past experience a sunk cost.
I'm in the exploration phase, figuring out what fits me.
I'll commit to one direction and go deep over the long run.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Industry and position, you must keep one.
✓ 地道说法：Hold on to at least one anchor—industry or role.
守用 hold on to an anchor 表达更地道。
✕ 直译腔：The sink cost is too big.
✓ 地道说法：The sunk cost is huge.
✕ 直译腔：Interest decides how much power you have.
✓ 地道说法：Interest determines your drive and motivation.
动力用 drive / motivation 而非 power。
✓ 地道说法：Go deep in this direction over the long run.
深耕用 go deep / double down 表达。
shifts: 凭感觉选职业，越换越迷茫
按阶段用策略选：老人守项、新人探索
换工作就想行业岗位一起换
换行不换岗、换岗不换行，至少守住一个
把迷茫当探索期正常信号，用三维度定位
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「任务工作」按语境校正为「螺丝钉工作」，「培生过来」校正为「打拼过来」，「是耕耘」校正为「深耕」，「成不成本」校正为「沉没成本」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
